sloka: प्रजाभिः सह शक्रश्च ययौ स्थानं स्वयम्भुवः ।कुम्भकर्णस्य दौरात्म्यं शशंसुस्ते प्रजापतेः ।। ६.६१.१९ ॥
transliteration: prajābhiḥ saha śakraśca yayau sthānaṁ svayambhuvaḥ ।kumbhakarṇasya daurātmyaṁ śaśaṁsuste prajāpateḥ ।। 6.61.19 ॥

translations.english: "They reported to Brahma about Kumbhakarna's ruthless deeds, devouring created beings, insulting, harsh and also destroying the abodes of sages violently and abducting others' wives."
